dedupe_keys.name: opencup open data on italian public investment projects cup system

description: OpenCUP publishes the information of the Italian CUP system, in which every public investment project receives a unique project code (Codice Unico di Progetto). The portal is run by the Department for the Planning and Coordination of Economic Policy of the Presidency of the Council of Ministers, jointly with the State General Accounting Department of the Ministry of Economy and Finance, to make data on public investment transparent. Since the new version launched in early 2024 it publishes the whole CUP information base in open format, covering project types such as public works and purchases of goods. It offers free-text search, CUP verification and templates, trend and data focus pages, open data downloads by macro-region and in full, and an API; a dataset updated to 1 September 2026 was announced on the home page. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: a CUP not shown on OpenCUP is not necessarily invalid, as the portal itself notes, and the site is in Italian. Coverage is Italy. It supports analysis of infrastructure investment across sectors, such as locating funded works on roads, schools, water and energy assets; there are no related records in the catalogue yet.
